app.name: FITD Wii Teste 03.1
app.short_description: GX original BODY models + SD log diagnostic fix
app.long_description: Preliminary PowerPC/GX homebrew technical prototype for the classic Alone in the Dark engine. Displays original LISTBODY.PAK 3D geometry over CAMERA00.PAK backgrounds using ITD_RESS palette. Browsable models, GX polygons, endian-safe SD archives and skeletal metadata diagnostics. NOT the playable FITD engine. NOT a playable game. Original game files are not included.
